explanation: The theorem says the order of G ⊓ centralizer(⟨x⟩) divides 180 = |GL₂(𝔽₄)|. This depends on the library's own definitions, namely fixV and hGLHom. hGLHom embeds the subgroup into GL₂(GaloisField 2 2). The proof combines that injective embedding with Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card and Matrix.card_GL_field. Mathlib has those general ingredients, but it has no declaration for this statement about elementary abelian 2-groups of order 16 with an order-3 fixed-point-free automorphism. I did not run a search of the Mathlib sources, so this answer rests on the form of the statement, not on a grep.
